---
title: "Bibliography"
---

Students are expected to be comfortable with college-level mathematics and science and are strongly encouraged to consult reliable reference texts. For example, foundational and practical texts in mathematics, applied thermodynamics and computational tools, including @bird2021, @bolton2021, @wylen1986, @solberg, @eastop1993a, @joel1996a, @granet2015, @shaw2017, @sweigart2021, and @sweigart2020.
